verdict.rationale: VLP's own Executive Compensation page says it designs, drafts and negotiates stock option and incentive plans and phantom unit plans, with related 409A tax advice. Its Emerging Growth page lists equity compensation as a practice area, so the core option-plan design is documented first-party. The story's international dimension has no support: nothing mentions UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP schemes, and the site appears US-only. Missing for 10: any evidence of local schemes such as UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOPs; detail on employee-wide (not just executive) plan programs; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: Designing, drafting and negotiating stock option and incentive plans, phantom unit plans, and cash bonus plans
We have extensive experience advising our clients on entity formation, capitalization, corporate governance, equity compensation and capital-raising matters
